subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Drawbacks**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Drawbacks** refer to the negative aspects or disadvantages of something. (कमियां)
 
• It is a noun and can be used in a sentence like: "*The drawbacks of using this software are its high cost and steep learning curve.*"
 
• It is often used in contrast to the advantages or benefits of something.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Snag **refers to an unexpected problem or obstacle that causes delay or difficulty. (रोड़ा)
 
• **Hitch **also refers to a problem or obstacle, but it is usually less severe than a snag. (अड़चन)
 
• **Liabilities **refer to legal or financial obligations or debts that a person or organization owes. (देयताएं)
